title: Page 238
transc:
Head Qrs A. P. Sept. 1 / 64
Maj. Eckert Di - Sheldon F
I think cab bell should be laid
on tremble side of windsor as it
will take less cab bell and will
be less danger of being dragged up
by anchors and channel most of way
is nearest waxy shore D do wren
Caldwell


Washington Sept. 9 / 64
G. D. Sheldon "F" Beckwith & Caldwell "U. S."
in number plug pembroke please make following
additions and insert the same in all
copies in use in your quadrants zebra
for tappan shelby burr bridge use Kent
and Kearney stop for shelter a Jay
Smith maynard and Macbeth zodiac for shelby
see C wash burn lavender and loadstone
zodiac in place of Schenck insert shelter
Jas. a mower in Koran and Kennet
unity in place of McPherson place shelby
James steed man mint and mogul answer
T. T. Eckert
